protocol.test_family: Three primary paired seed contrasts, Holm t and exhaustive sign flips separately. Remaining comparisons exploratory.
protocol.design: Every branch follows intact grid until first goal. Then select intact grid/PGC actor everywhere, only within0.6m of true goal, or only outside0.6m. Both frozen RNNs receive their native current/goal codes, the branch actual observations/actions/rewards, and maintain separate natural h/c. No neural state is transferred across models.
caveats: Uses privileged goal distance to choose controller; diagnostic not deployable policy.
Switching controller changes future trajectories and both shadow-state histories.
PGC-after-discovery is not the original native PGC policy before discovery.
Localizes usefulness of learned controllers; does not identify individual neurons or fully explain training.

statistics: Eight training seeds are replicates. Marginal95%paired t intervals; Holm t and exactsignflip within listed primary and exploratory families separately. Other endpoints secondary. Research followup on existing evaluation layouts.
